description: Upload one or more files and get a public URL plus GitHub-ready markdown. Prefer `embedUrl` in GitHub markdown. Pass `contentUrl` for a public HTTPS file, or http://localhost on this machine, instead of a local path. With `pr`/`issue`, keys are stable and the managed comment is synced. All uploads are public. Accepts images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, AVIF), video (MP4, WebM, MOV), PDF, zip, gzip, and text (plain, markdown, CSV, JSON). SVG and XML are accepted only on storage lanes verified to serve them sandboxed (see the workspace's storage settings); HTML is rejected.

alt.description: Alt text for the markdown (default: each file's name; with multiple files applies to all).

app.description: Which surface is shown: web, ios, android, cli. Worth setting only when the same route exists on more than one surface.

comment.description: With `pr`/`issue` (or an auto-detected PR): create or update the managed attachments comment. Best-effort.

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded file content for in-memory uploads; requires filename.

contentType.description: Override the Content-Type (ignored when optimize rewrites the body).

contentUrl.description: URL to fetch and upload. Public HTTPS, or http://localhost / 127.0.0.1 / *.localhost on this machine. Filename is optional when the URL path has a leaf. Other private/internal hosts are rejected. Exactly one of file, files, contentBase64, or contentUrl.

destination.description: Typed destination root: screenshots | gh | f. Sets the key prefix; first-class alternative to prefix. With pr/issue must be gh or omitted.

dryRun.description: Resolve key + public URL without uploading (also previews a strict-key refusal via wouldRefuse). Not with comment.

file.description: Path of a single file to upload. Exactly one of file, files, contentBase64, or contentUrl is required.

filename.description: Filename for contentBase64/contentUrl (drives the key and content type). With single `file`, overrides the key's leaf (clean name) while keeping the pr/default path.

files.description: Paths of multiple files to upload in parallel. Returns { uploads, failures }. Cannot combine with file, contentBase64, contentUrl, key, or filename.

frame.description: Optional frame before optimize: phone | browser | iphone-16-pro.

issue.description: Attach to this issue. Mutually exclusive with pr.

keepExif.description: Keep EXIF/XMP/ICC when optimizing (default: strip for privacy on public embeds).

key.description: Override the object key. Single file only; cannot combine with `pr`/`issue`.

metadata.description: Queryable tags for later search (key→value). Use `path` for the route (e.g. /settings), not route/page/screen. Omit to leave existing tags; pass an object (even {}) to replace them. `state` and `app` have their own fields.

noGit.description: Don't derive the repo segment from git.

noOptimize.description: Skip client-side image optimization (default: optimize still images to WebP).

noPr.description: Skip auto-PR context (issue #700): without pr/issue/key/ref/prefix/destination, a call on a branch mapping to exactly one open PR otherwise behaves as if pr had been passed (stable key + managed comment sync when comment is set). Also opts out via UPLOADS_NO_AUTO_PR=1.

optimizeMaxEdge.description: Max long edge in pixels when optimizing (default: 2400).

pr.description: Attach to this pull request. Mutually exclusive with issue.

prefix.description: Key prefix (default: screenshots, or UPLOADS_DEFAULT_PREFIX). Cannot be combined with pr/issue.

ref.description: PR/issue/branch key segment (default: today, or UPLOADS_DEFAULT_REF). Cannot be combined with pr/issue.

replace.description: Overwrite an existing object on a non-`gh/` key. Default false (or true if UPLOADS_OVERWRITE=1). No effect on `pr`/`issue` keys, which always overwrite.

repo.description: owner/name repo segment (default: git remote, or UPLOADS_DEFAULT_REPO).

state.description: The UI state this image shows. Set it whenever the image is one side of a comparison — before/after is the most useful pair in a PR, and is what makes `find_files` with state=after work later.

width.description: Emit markdown instead of a plain image embed.

workspace.description: Override the workspace for this call (like the CLI's --workspace flag).

name: put
title: Upload file
